release_notes: Two layout changes to the Ready Messages log that 1.0.61's font-tier-only change exposed. (1) The timestamp now sits at the END of each line — 'Room 1: Ready  [02:30 PM]' — instead of at the start. The eye reads the sender and the action before the time, which is the order that matters at a glance. (2) Smaller-font lines (the second-most-recent incoming Ready and every older line) are now padded vertically so every line in the log takes the same height as the recent1 (15pt bold) tier. Previously the larger font on the most-recent line made it look like there was more vertical space around it; with equalized padding, the pitch from line to line is identical across all three tiers. The padding values are computed per-theme from each font's linespace metric, so they stay correct on systems that substitute a fallback font with different vertical metrics. Lines persisted in the pre-1.0.62 layout still load cleanly — body detection falls back to tagging the whole line if it can't find the new body/timestamp separator.
